observations.summary: Reuters reports Saudi-led coalition acknowledgment of a Houthi missile threat toward Riyadh, a loud boom, and initial reports of falling debris and material damage; Saudi Civil Defense issued and later lifted a protective warning. Exact strike time, target, damage extent and independent battle-damage confirmation remain unavailable. Distinct from previously reported southern Saudi interception. Existing Houthi-Saudi conflict remains active; not proof of new regional war phase.
observations.title: Saudi coalition reports new Houthi missile threat to Riyadh and debris damage
